tool_input.command:
hops sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab6dffb7_featurestore --no-verify --json --limit 0 "
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_rows,
       min(is_weekend) AS min_wk, max(is_weekend) AS max_wk,
       sum(is_weekend) AS weekend_rows,
       round(min(amount_usd),4) AS min_usd, round(max(amount_7d),4) AS max_7d
FROM features4018d5_1
" 2>/dev/null | tail -20

hops sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab6dffb7_featurestore --no-verify --json --limit 0 "
WITH win AS (
  SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time, t.amount,
    SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
  FROM transactions_raw_1 t
),
sub AS (
  SELECT a.row_id,
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM transactions_raw_1 b
      WHERE b.account_id=a.account_id AND b.event_time BETWEEN a.event_time-604800000 AND a.event_time) AS s
  FROM transactions_raw_1 a
)
SELECT count(*) AS mismatches
FROM win JOIN sub USING(row_id)
WHERE abs(win.w - sub.s) > 0.0001
" 2>/dev/null | tail -8
echo "=== cross-check stored table vs recomputed window ==="
hops sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab6dffb7_featurestore --no-verify --json --limit 0 "
WITH expect AS (
  SELECT t.row_id,
    t.amount*f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
    CASE WHEN day_of_week(from_unixtime(t.event_time/1000,'UTC')) IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
    SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
  FROM transactions_raw_1 t JOIN fx_rates_raw_1 f ON t.currency=f.currency
)
SELECT count(*) AS bad
FROM features4018d5_1 g JOIN expect e USING(row_id)
WHERE abs(g.amount_usd-e.amount_usd)>0.0001 OR g.is_weekend<>e.is_weekend OR abs(g.amount_7d-e.amount_7d)>0.0001
" 2>/dev/null | tail -8
tool_input.description: Verify window vs subquery and stored vs expected
